prompt: Can you write me an email telling my boss that I will be out because I am going on a vacation that was planned months ago?
response:
Sure, here's a draft for you:

Subject: Vacation Confirmation

Dear [Boss's Name],

I hope this email finds you well. I'm writing to inform you that I will be taking a vacation from [start date] to [end date]. This vacation was planned months ago and is part of my personal schedule. Rest assured, I will ensure all my tasks are completed before my absence and have arranged for a colleague to cover my responsibilities during my vacation. Please let me know if you need any additional information.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
